say:0:1422201001:0.text: We can't get back into the camp. Oh no...
say:0:1422201001:0.source_cn: 营地进不去了，这下可闯祸了……

say:2:1422202001:1.text: Well, if it isn't Zanie! Haven't seen you in a while. And who's this with you?
say:2:1422202001:1.source_cn: 哟嚯！是祖娅啊！好些日子没见了。还有这位……

say:3:1422202002:1.text: This here is my magical tech consultant! You know how it is—sometimes you need a little magic to get the job done...
say:3:1422202002:1.source_cn: 这位是我的魔法技术顾问！你懂的，有些工艺少不了魔法辅助……
say:3:1422202002:1.male: This here is my magical tech consultant! You know how it is—sometimes you need a little magic to get the job done...
say:3:1422202002:1.female: This here is my magical tech consultant! You know how it is—sometimes you need a little magic to get the job done...

say:4:1422202003:1.text: Alright, alright, save the speech, Zanie. Listen, I broke a pipe! If the Essail find out, I'm in big trouble!
say:4:1422202003:1.source_cn: 我现在没空关心这些了，祖娅，我把管道搞坏啦！要是被那些...

choice_prompt:5:1422202003.text: Alright, alright, save the speech, Zanie. Listen, I broke a pipe! If the Essail find out, I'm in big trouble!
choice_prompt:5:1422202003.source_cn: 我现在没空关心这些了，祖娅，我把管道搞坏啦！要是被那些艾什么勒发现，我都不敢想会怎么样！

say:6:1422202004:1.text: Nothing yet, but a new shipment's on its way... If I can't get it fixed before it arrives, I'm done for!
say:6:1422202004:1.source_cn: 现在还没有，但马上就会有新一批……总之，修不好管道，我...

say:7:1422202005:1.text: Come on, Torg. You used to be the best repairman around! Don't tell me you've forgotten how to fix a pipe.
say:7:1422202005:1.source_cn: 老伙计，年轻那会儿你可是一等一的维修好手！怎么现在修条...

say:8:1422202006:1.text: It's not that simple... I wouldn't even know where to start. Just come with me to the camp, and I'll show you what I'm dealing with.
say:8:1422202006:1.source_cn: 情况有点复杂……真不知道该从哪说起，你们跟我去营地看一...

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 有东西在通过管道运输？

say:1:1422204001:1.text: What's happening? Why are your mechanical guards attacking us?
say:1:1422204001:1.source_cn: 这是什么情况？矮人制造的机械守卫怎么在攻击矮人？

say:5:1422204002:1.text: Because I broke a pipe! No, because you two upgraded their control system!! All I did was damage a pipe, and now they think I'm a Class A intruder!
say:5:1422204002:1.source_cn: 因为我弄坏了管道……不，都是因为你们俩升级了机械守卫的...

say:6:1422204003:0.text: I did upgrade their alert system. Maybe I made them a bit too... overzealous.
say:6:1422204003:0.source_cn: 我的确加强了铁脑袋们的警戒系统，调高了警戒等级，它们对...

say:7:1422204004:1.text: But I never programmed them to attack dwarves! Every upgrade was done with safety in mind!
say:7:1422204004:1.source_cn: 但我可没有让它们攻击矮人！升级都是在安全的前提下进行的！

say:8:1422204005:0.text: Oh really? Then what about that cannonball that nearly took my head off?
say:8:1422204005:0.source_cn: 那刚刚擦着我的头飞过的炮弹是什么？！

say:9:1422204006:1.text: Oh, that? Just gave them a little firepower. They're a lot tougher now, don't you think?
say:9:1422204006:1.source_cn: 嚯，那是我给铁脑袋们加装的火力装置，作战系统大提升，怎...

say:12:1422204007:1.text: Tougher? They could easily wipe out a whole squad of dwarves!
say:12:1422204007:1.source_cn: 确实威力十足，火力足够把十个矮人干趴下。

say:13:1422204008:0.text: And thanks to that firepower, we can't even set foot in the camp without getting blasted to bits!
say:13:1422204008:0.source_cn: 这火力也把我们都赶出了营地！进去就会变成炮灰！

say:14:1422204009:0.text: That's not my fault! Your alert system thinks we're Class A intruders. My upgrades only kick in if something's flagged as Class A!
say:14:1422204009:0.source_cn: 还不是拜你的警戒系统所赐，我的装置只对A类入侵者开火！...

say:17:1422204010:1.text: Enough! I just want to get the pipe fixed!
say:17:1422204010:1.source_cn: 别吵别吵！我只想把管道修好……

say:18:1422204011:0.text: Zanie, you've done some weapons research, right? Any ideas for something that could take out those mechanical guards without too much fuss?
say:18:1422204011:0.source_cn: 祖娅，你不是也喜欢研究武器吗，有没有什么武器威力不大不...

say:19:1422204012:0.text: Ahem. I don't think that's really necessary.
say:19:1422204012:0.source_cn: 咳咳，我觉得没有这个必要。

say:20:1422204013:1.text: They're just doing their job! Can't really blame them!
say:20:1422204013:1.source_cn: 铁脑袋们只是在执行命令，它们有什么错！

say:21:1422204014:1.text: We just need to shut down their control system. By the way, the controller is all the way at the north end of the camp.
say:21:1422204014:1.source_cn: 只要把它们的控制系统关掉就好了，控制器就在营地最北边。

say:22:1422204015:1.text: Why wasn't I told about this controller before?
say:22:1422204015:1.source_cn: 我怎么不知道还有控制器？

say:23:1422204016:0.text: Well, we thought the original startup process was too complicated, so we made a few adjustments.
say:23:1422204016:0.source_cn: 我们觉得之前的启动程序太过繁琐，进行了一些小小的改装。

say:24:1422204017:0.text: I panicked when I ran out of the camp and ended up running in the opposite direction of the controller...
say:24:1422204017:0.source_cn: 刚刚从营地跑出来的时候太慌张，往控制器的反方向跑了……

say:27:1422204018:1.text: So, we just need to sneak past the guards and shut down the controller... This sounds like a job best handled by <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:27:1422204018:1.source_cn: 不惊动机械守卫的前提下，穿过营地，关掉控制器……看来只...
say:27:1422204018:1.male: So, we just need to sneak past the guards and shut down the controller... This sounds like a job best handled by <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:27:1422204018:1.female: So, we just need to sneak past the guards and shut down the controller... This sounds like a job best handled by <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:28:1422204019:0.text: You know, at least he has magic to protect himself when things go south. We don't have that!
say:28:1422204019:0.source_cn: 比起我们，必要的时候，<male>他</male><f...
say:28:1422204019:0.male: You know, at least he has magic to protect himself when things go south. We don't have that!
say:28:1422204019:0.female: You know, at least she has magic to protect herself when things go south. We don't have that!

say:31:1422204020:0.text: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!
say:31:1422204020:0.source_cn: 你真的能……不，你真的愿意帮忙……？这可是需要极大勇气...
say:31:1422204020:0.male: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!
say:31:1422204020:0.female: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!

choice_prompt:32:1422204020.text: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!
choice_prompt:32:1422204020.source_cn: 你真的能……不，你真的愿意帮忙……？这可是需要极大勇气的行动！
choice_prompt:32:1422204020.male: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!
choice_prompt:32:1422204020.female: You'd really help...? Are you sure about this? I mean... it's going to be very dangerous!

say:33:1422204021:0.text: Thank you! I'll be forever in your debt.
say:33:1422204021:0.source_cn: 你有这份心，真是太感动了。
say:33:1422204021:0.male: Thank you! I'll be forever in your debt.
say:33:1422204021:0.female: Thank you! I'll be forever in your debt.

say:34:1422204024:0.text: All right! Just slip past the guards, reach the controller at the north end of the camp, and shut it down. You've got this!
say:34:1422204024:0.source_cn: 上吧！躲开这些机械守卫，把营地北边的控制器关掉，你一定...
say:34:1422204024:0.male: All right! Just slip past the guards, reach the controller at the north end of the camp, and shut it down. You've got this!
say:34:1422204024:0.female: All right! Just slip past the guards, reach the controller at the north end of the camp, and shut it down. You've got this!

choice:32:0:1.text: I'll do it for the pipe.
choice:32:0:1.male: I'll do it for the pipe.
choice:32:0:1.female: I'll do it for the pipe.

say:37:1422204022:0.text: Oh, you're a fan of mechanical guards too? That's wonderful!
say:37:1422204022:0.source_cn: 你也懂机械守卫的艺术？好样的！
say:37:1422204022:0.male: Oh, you're a fan of mechanical guards too? That's wonderful!
say:37:1422204022:0.female: Oh, you're a fan of mechanical guards too? That's wonderful!

choice:32:1:2.text: I'll do it for the guards.
choice:32:1:2.male: I'll do it for the guards.
choice:32:1:2.female: I'll do it for the guards.

say:38:1422204023:0.text: Yeah, I get it. Your silence says it all.
say:38:1422204023:0.source_cn: 虽然你什么都没说，但是我懂你的意思。
say:38:1422204023:0.male: Yeah, I get it. Your silence says it all.
say:38:1422204023:0.female: Yeah, I get it. Your silence says it all.

say:0:1422211001:0.text: The controller has gone haywire... Maybe a bit of magic will make it stop.
say:0:1422211001:0.source_cn: 控制器完全失灵了……试试用魔法让它停下。
say:0:1422211001:0.male: The controller has gone haywire... Maybe a bit of magic will make it stop.
say:0:1422211001:0.female: The controller has gone haywire... Maybe a bit of magic will make it stop.

say:0:1422212001:0.text: The mechanical guards have stopped attacking.
say:0:1422212001:0.source_cn: 机械守卫都停止攻击了。
say:0:1422212001:0.male: The mechanical guards have stopped attacking.
say:0:1422212001:0.female: The mechanical guards have stopped attacking.

say:0:1422213001:0.text: ...Class A intruder... non-Class A... not an intruder...

say:0:1422213101:0.text: These concepts are all mixed up...
say:0:1422213101:0.source_cn: 这些概念已经被彻底混淆了吧……
say:0:1422213101:0.male: These concepts are all mixed up...
say:0:1422213101:0.female: These concepts are all mixed up...

say:0:1422214101:0.text: The malfunction could be caused by the system update.
say:0:1422214101:0.source_cn: 看来故障确实和系统更新有关。
say:0:1422214101:0.male: The malfunction could be caused by the system update.
say:0:1422214101:0.female: The malfunction could be caused by the system update.

say:0:1422215101:0.text: Even under such circumstances, they are still protecting the dwarves...
say:0:1422215101:0.source_cn: 即使这样也没有忘记保护矮人的职责吗……
say:0:1422215101:0.male: Even under such circumstances, they are still protecting the dwarves...
say:0:1422215101:0.female: Even under such circumstances, they are still protecting the dwarves...

say:2:1422216001:0.text: You stopped the guards from attacking, and you fixed the pipe! Amazing!
say:2:1422216001:0.source_cn: 机械守卫停止了攻击，你还帮我修好了管道！
say:2:1422216001:0.male: You stopped the guards from attacking, and you fixed the pipe! Amazing!
say:2:1422216001:0.female: You stopped the guards from attacking, and you fixed the pipe! Amazing!

say:3:1422216002:0.text: Zanie, your consultant is really something.
say:3:1422216002:0.source_cn: 祖娅，你这位顾问可真是了不起。
say:3:1422216002:0.male: Zanie, your consultant is really something.
say:3:1422216002:0.female: Zanie, your consultant is really something.

say:4:1422216003:0.text: You bet! But wait, did I hear those guards talking? And was each one saying something different?
say:4:1422216003:0.source_cn: 那可不。不过刚才我没听错的话，这些机械守卫在说话？说的...

say:5:1422216004:0.text: What?! No! They aren't supposed to talk! Did somebody install a language module on them?!
say:5:1422216004:0.source_cn: 啊？在说话！之前没有这个功能啊？谁又给它们加上了语言模块！

say:11:1422216007:0.text: Rule number one for mechanical guards: If they're working, don't tinker with their systems!
say:11:1422216007:0.source_cn: 机械守卫第一法则，只要机械守卫能跑起来，就不要乱动它的系统！

say:12:1422216008:0.text: Keep messing with them, and they're just going to get weirder and weirder!
say:12:1422216008:0.source_cn: 你们这样改造下去，它们会越来越奇怪的！

say:13:1422216009:0.text: If we reset the alert system, everything should go back to normal.
say:13:1422216009:0.source_cn: 我相信，只要它们的警戒系统恢复原状，一切都会变得正常。

say:14:1422216010:0.text: It's your combat system that needs fixing!
say:14:1422216010:0.source_cn: 要改的是你的作战系统！

say:17:1422216011:0.text: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?
say:17:1422216011:0.source_cn: ……我想起我和我的顾问还有些事，就先不打扰了，你说是吧？
say:17:1422216011:0.male: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?
say:17:1422216011:0.female: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?

choice_prompt:18:1422216011.text: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?
choice_prompt:18:1422216011.source_cn: ……我想起我和我的顾问还有些事，就先不打扰了，你说是吧？
choice_prompt:18:1422216011.male: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?
choice_prompt:18:1422216011.female: Um, you know what? My consultant and I have some pressing matters to attend to. We'll just be on our way. Right?

say:19:1422216012:1.text: Thanks a ton! I'll get you out of here on the camp's mine cart. You're always welcome back!
say:19:1422216012:1.source_cn: 真是麻烦你们了！我带你们坐营地的矿车，送你们出去！欢迎...

say:20:1422216013:1.text: As for those two, they can argue forever for all I care.
say:20:1422216013:1.source_cn: 至于他俩，就让他们永无止境地吵下去吧……

say:0:1422217001:0.source_cn: 就是这里啦！再见了朋友！

say:1:1422217002:0.text: Farewell! I hope your guards are back to normal soon!
say:1:1422217002:0.source_cn: 再会了，希望你们的铁脑袋早日恢复正常！
